environment.description: AWS Lambda function running in Step Functions Express workflow. The function executes in us-east-1 with Node.js 18.x runtime. The S3 context bucket has versioning disabled. The Lambda has an execution role with s3:*, sns:*, and states:* permissions. The callback endpoint URLs stored in execution contexts point to an external HTTPS endpoint controlled by the workflow initiator. No content validation is performed on fetched scripts before vm execution. CloudFront is not in the request path - Lambda fetches directly from the callback URL.
